theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_sp_density_mult_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.Represents C → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → HasMassDensity C y k → y ∈ R.carrier ∧ R.mult y = k
